text_en: Now during those days, when the disciples were increasing in number, the Hellenists complained against the Hebrews because their widows were being neglected in the daily distribution of food.
text_cn: 那时候，门徒们渐渐增多，希腊化的犹太人，对希伯来人发出了怨言，因为他们在日常的供应品上，疏忽了他们的寡妇。

text_en: And the twelve called together the whole community of the disciples and said, “It is not right that we should neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
text_cn: 于是十二宗徒召集众门徒说：“让我们放弃天主的圣言，而操管饮食，实在不相宜。

text_en: Therefore, friends, select from among yourselves seven men of good standing, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint to this task,
text_cn: 所以，弟兄们！当从你们中检定七位有好声望，且充满圣神和智慧的人，派他们管这要务。

text_en: while we, for our part, will devote ourselves to prayer and to serving the word. ”
text_cn: 至于我们，我们要专务祈祷，并为真道服役。”

text_en: What they said pleased the whole community, and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, together with Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch.
text_cn: 这番话得了全体的悦服，就选了斯德望，他是位充满信德和圣神的人，和斐理伯、仆洛曷洛、尼加诺尔、提孟、帕尔默纳及尼苛劳，他是个归依犹太教的安提约基雅人，

text_en: They had these men stand before the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
text_cn: 叫他们立在宗徒面前；宗徒们祈祷以后，就给他们覆了手。

text_en: The word of God continued to spread; the number of the disciples increased greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests became obedient to the faith.
text_cn: 天主的道渐渐发扬，门徒的数目在耶路撒冷大为增加，司祭中也有许多人，服从了信仰。

text_en: Stephen, full of grace and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.
text_cn: 斯德望充满恩宠和德能，在百姓中显大奇迹，行大征兆。

text_en: Then some of those who belonged to the synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called), Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and others of those from Cilicia and Asia, stood up and argued with Stephen.
text_cn: 当时，有些称为“自由人”会堂中的人，以及基勒乃和亚历山大里亚人的会堂的人，还有些属基里基雅和亚细亚会堂的人，起来，同斯德望辩论；

text_en: But they could not withstand the wisdom and the Spirit with which he spoke.
text_cn: 但是他们敌不住他的智慧，因为他是藉圣神说话。

text_en: Then they secretly instigated some men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God. ”
text_cn: 于是他们便怂恿一些人，说：“我们听见他说过亵渎梅瑟和天主的话。”

text_en: They stirred up the people as well as the elders and the scribes; then they suddenly confronted him, seized him, and brought him before the council.
text_cn: 他们又煽动了百姓、长老和经师，一同跑来，捉住了他，解送到公议会。

text_en: They set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops saying things against this holy place and the law;
text_cn: 他们并设下假见证，说：“这人不断地说反对圣地和法律的话，

text_en: for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and will change the customs that Moses handed on to us. ”
text_cn: 因为我们曾听见他说：这个纳匝肋人耶稣要毁灭这个地方，并要改革梅瑟给我们传下的常例。”

text_en: And all who sat in the council looked intently at him, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
text_cn: 所有坐在公议会的人都注目看他，见他的面容好像天使的面容。
